circuit.name: Single Phase Diode Bridge Rectifier
circuit.description: A classic AC to DC full-bridge rectifier translating a 24V peak 160Hz AC source into a DC output across a 9-ohm load, utilizing 1N5818 Schottky diodes.

requirements.requirement: Verify full-wave rectification and output ripple.

data.name: Vout_avg
data.description: Average Output Voltage in steady state (last 15ms)

data.name: Vout_ripple_vpp
data.description: Output Ripple peak-to-peak in steady state
